Policy: AI tools may assist manuscript drafting but must be transparently disclosed (Methods/Acknowledgements); grammar/spell-check tools excluded from disclosure; AI cannot be an author; AI must not be used to generate/alter research data/results; author retains full responsibility for accuracy.
